scope: 2v2 classic Flip integration and Discord payload contract only

scenarios.behavior: Flip Summon targets and destroys one opposing-team monster; the physical UID remains in the opposing shared GY; face-down opponent identity stays hidden from public and opposing team panels; own teammate can inspect own face-down card.
Flip Summon retrieves only a Spell from the shared team GY to the active representative's private hand; the inactive partner hand remains isolated; public Discord panel does not expose physical UIDs.

validation.databaseWrites: only isolated temporary SQLite path used by tagUI/tagStore module initialization; no player records or production database touched

limitations: This is an integration test against the local 2v2 duel and Discord payload builders; it is not a live Discord gateway/server test.
The two cards were already registered/certified in the shared engine; M428 adds no card certification.
No command registration or runtime effect code was changed.
